description: Read blockchain data through Etherscan's official API: native and token balances, full transaction and transfer history, internal transactions, event logs, verified contract source and ABIs, gas prices and network statistics. One API key reaches Ethereum and 60+ other EVM chains - Base, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, BNB Chain and the rest - picked per step from a dropdown. Also reaches a node directly for blocks, receipts, read-only contract calls and gas estimates. Every action works on Etherscan's free plan.
